law_name: Act No. 18/2018 Coll. on Personal Data Protection and on Amending and Supplementing Certain Acts
key_requirements: Mirrors GDPR with national exceptions, Office's powers, administrative fines
enforcement_authority: Office for Personal Data Protection of the Slovak Republic
deceased_data: Protected, no time limit found: where consent is needed, a close person (relative/spouse) may give it, invalid if any close person objects in writing (special situations, § 78)
research_exemption: Archiving, scientific/historical research and statistics handled under special processing situations (§ 78) with art. 89 GDPR safeguards; exact wording not confirmed (unconfirmed)
genetic_data: Genetic, biometric and health data may be processed only where a specific law or international treaty provides (art. 9(4) GDPR option); no specific genetic-data or biobank law
notes: Replaced Act 122/2013; also transposes Law Enforcement Directive; promulgated 30 Jan 2018
